title: Construct String from Binary Tree
summary: Given the root node of a binary tree, generate a string representation using preorder traversal.
statement: Given the root node of a binary tree, generate a string representation using preorder traversal. Each node is represented by its integer value. If a node has one or both children, their values are enclosed in parentheses. Empty parentheses are omitted in most cases, but if a node has a right child but no left child, include an empty pair of parentheses to accurately reflect the tree's structure.
constraints: Use preorder; include () for a missing left child only when a right child exists.
